notes.title: Together in Forgotten Lands: Chapter One will be released for free on July 4th!
notes.content:
[p]In this first chapter, you'll open the doors to a mysterious cave and step into the depths of a forgotten world.[/p][p][/p][p]🧩 Our game is fully designed as a two-player co-op experience, featuring a variety of unique puzzles and four distinct biomes.
🕯️ Play with light, uncover secrets, and face the living, shifting nature of the cave.[/p][p][/p][p]🎯 Chapter One will be available to play for free on July 4th.
👉 Add it to your [b]Steam Wishlist[/b] to be notified at launch![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3723610/Together_in_Forgotten_Lands_Chapter_One/" style="button"]🔗 Check Out Our Steam Page[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="a7-ZNEm8TU8;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 🧩 Together in Forgotten Lands: Chapter One is now on Steam! 🎉
notes.content:
[b]Hello explorers![/b]

Are you ready to uncover the secrets of Together in Forgotten Lands: Chapter One, our new co-op puzzle adventure?

In this free Prologue, you and your partner will step into a living, time-lost cave and experience one of four unique biomes filled with mystery.

👥 Designed exclusively for two players.
🌿 Explore one of four distinct biomes, each with its own unique mechanics.
🧠 Solve puzzles based on light, rhythm, and platforming challenges.
🔄 Put your teamwork to the test.

🗝️ This is just the beginning. What you learn here will prepare you for the main game's challenges.

📌 Add the game to your Steam wishlist to support us!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3723610/Together_in_Forgotten_Lands_Chapter_One/]Steam Page[/url]

💬 Join us and discover the cave’s secrets together.

[previewyoutube=a7-ZNEm8TU8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Vellichor Games Team[/b]

notes.title: 📌 Name Update
notes.content:
[b]📌 Name Update[/b]

To prevent any potential copyright issues, we’ve renamed the game from “Together in Forgotten Realms” to Together in Forgotten Lands.

Same excitement, new name — the journey continues! 🎮💫

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508501/87f86d48df078300dcfbb2f3734937f678f75478.png[/img]

📝 Don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam and join us on this mysterious co-op adventure! 🧩💖

notes.title: 🚀 Together in Forgotten Realms Surpasses 1,000 Wishlists in Just One Week! 🎉
notes.content:
[b]We are thrilled to announce that Together in Forgotten Realms has already surpassed 1,000 wishlists on Steam, and we couldn’t have done it without the big support of our community! 🙌[/b]

Thank you to everyone who has added the game to their wishlist and shown their enthusiasm for this exciting journey. We’re working hard to bring you the best possible experience and can’t wait to share more updates with you soon!
